changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO owned_plots (id, created_at, deleted, buyer_user_id, transaction_id, plot_id, estate_id, seller_tenant_id, status, plan, intent, base_price, corner_premium_pct, total_price, currency, acquired_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), false, t.buyer_user_id, t.id, t.plot_id, t.estate_id, t.seller_tenant_id, 'COMPLETED', t.plan, t.intent, t.base_price, t.corner_premium_pct, t.total_price, t.currency, COALESCE((SELECT max(a.created_at) FROM audit_log_entries a WHERE a.action = 'transaction.verified' AND a.target_id = t.id), t.updated_at, t.created_at) FROM transactions t WHERE t.status = 'VERIFIED' AND t.deleted = false;
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM owned_plots WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION landvault_buyer_plot_details(p_buyer uuid) RETURNS TABLE ( plot_id uuid, plot_number varchar, block_name varchar, is_corner boolean, nominal_size_sqm numeric, actual_area_sqm numeric, estate_id uuid, estate_name varchar, estate_area varchar, estate_city varchar, estate_state varchar, title_type varchar, title_status varchar ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT p.id, p.plot_number, b.name, p.is_corner, p.nominal_size_sqm, p.actual_area_sqm, e.id, e.name, e.area, e.city, e.state, t.title_type, t.status FROM plots p JOIN estates e ON e.id = p.estate_id LEFT JOIN blocks b ON b.id = p.block_id LEFT JOIN estate_titles t ON t.estate_id = e.id AND t.deleted = false WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT tr.plot_id FROM transactions tr WHERE tr.buyer_user_id = p_buyer AND tr.status IN ('AWAITING_FINANCE', 'VERIFIED') UNION SELECT o.plot_id FROM owned_plots o WHERE o.buyer_user_id = p_buyer AND o.deleted = false ) $$; REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION landvault_buyer_plot_details(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION landvault_buyer_plot_details(uuid) TO ${appDbUsername};
